implement_score.why: Worth 30 minutes: clone, read the 'What You'll Learn' guides, and cherry-pick 3-5 skills (memory persistence hooks, continuous-learning, security scan, verification loop) into Haji's own plugin rather than installing everything. Also compare with GStack and Addy Osmani agent-skills already liked.
